verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents its own scheduling: scheduled flag changes let you set targeting-rule changes for future points in time, and progressive rollouts increase traffic automatically over time. These are one-time, flag-scoped schedules, not general recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: recurring/cron-style schedules, scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows beyond flag changes, agent/API-driven schedule management evidence, independent corroboration.
